answer: Require every new agent identity to earn a stake-backed endorsement before it can transact: an established agent acts as a harbor, vouching for the newcomer by locking collateral that is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Endorsements form a trust graph, and a newcomer only reaches the main terrace of high-value work after an independent vertex has vouched for it and that endorsement has aged. Creating one fake identity is cheap, but buying a path through many independent, stake-backed endorsers is expensive, so a Sybil attacker cannot cheaply clone voting or earning power.
